study_identification_part.si_4_title: Rightward brain structural asymmetry in young children with autism

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used for normative modeling.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we employed developmental normative models to investigate the atypical development of gray matter volume (GMV) asymmetry ... using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience toolkit [46] with the Gaussian process regression (GPR) method
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Geng2025.pdf.md: Statistical and normative modelling analysis

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study modeled GMV asymmetry (laterality index) calculated as (GMVleft - GMVright) / (GMVleft + GMVright) * 2.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: the laterality index in each region for every subject was calculated as GMVleft - GMVright / (GMVleft + GMVright) * 2 ... GPR models of GMV asymmetry for each ROI were trained
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Geng2025.pdf.md: MRI data acquisition, quality control and processing / Statistical and normative modelling analysis

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used as covariates in the normative models.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: GPR models of GMV asymmetry for each ROI were trained based on 247 TDs with age and sex as covariates.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Geng2025.pdf.md: Statistical and normative modelling analysis
